description: This file defines an immutable Java class VoicemailImpl that implements the Voicemail interface. It encapsulates voicemail data such as id, number, timestamp, duration, source, source data, URI, read status, and content presence. The class includes nested Builder class for flexible object creation and various getter methods.

classes.name: VoicemailImpl
classes.description: Immutable data object representing a voicemail, with a nested Builder class for construction.

classes.name: VoicemailImpl.Builder
classes.description: Builder pattern implementation for creating VoicemailImpl instances with optional fields.

methods.name: createForInsertion
methods.description: Creates a Builder for a new Voicemail to be inserted, requiring timestamp and number.

methods.name: createForUpdate
methods.description: Creates a Builder for updating a Voicemail, requiring the voicemail id.

methods.name: createEmptyBuilder
methods.description: Creates a Builder for a new Voicemail instance with no preset fields.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs a VoicemailImpl instance from fields set in the Builder.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the voicemail id, or -1 if not set.

methods.name: hasId
methods.description: Checks if the id is set.

methods.name: getNumber
methods.description: Returns the voicemail number.

methods.name: hasNumber
methods.description: Checks if the number is set.

methods.name: getTimestampMillis
methods.description: Returns the timestamp in milliseconds.

methods.name: hasTimestampMillis
methods.description: Checks if the timestamp is set.

methods.name: getDuration
methods.description: Returns the voicemail duration.

methods.name: hasDuration
methods.description: Checks if the duration is set.

methods.name: getSourcePackage
methods.description: Returns the source package string.

methods.name: hasSourcePackage
methods.description: Checks if the source package is set.

methods.name: getSourceData
methods.description: Returns the source data string.

methods.name: hasSourceData
methods.description: Checks if the source data is set.

methods.name: getUri
methods.description: Returns the Uri associated with the voicemail.

methods.name: hasUri
methods.description: Checks if the Uri is set.

methods.name: isRead
methods.description: Returns the read status.

methods.name: hasRead
methods.description: Checks if the read status is set.

methods.name: hasContent
methods.description: Checks if the voicemail has associated content.
